title: PUBLIC REPORT COPY TEXT
why: Strangers do not know Daniel. The Thanksgiving build needs useful report actions without a private contact instruction.
now: Report help names the raid log. A successful copy says report copied.

edits.anchor: Every raid is logged here. Copy it out and send it to Daniel so the game can be tuned on real play.
Copy report puts this raid, and every raid before it, on your clipboard. Paste it to Daniel and the game gets fixed from it.
